evidenceBoundary.exact: Complete current owned caller/helper/bulk windows and six selected original instruction blocks, including correct REX.X SIB indices and qword byte-address arithmetic.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Current five managed Array.Copy arguments forward to the fast helper. Its selected same-element branch passes length times runtime stride and source/destination indexed byte addresses to the actual bulk entry, then checks an optional static-bitset update and returns AL true.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Runtime array-class/shape/element/stride slots and the optional static bitset have compiled representations; their initialized provider meanings are not promoted to named layouts.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Non-null compatible arrays, nonnegative indices/length, selected shape/rank and bounds outcomes without integer overflow, the ordinary element-class edge and equal element-class pointers, normal bulk return with required nonvolatile registers preserved, and successful optional compare/exchange completion.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Bulk byte-copy implementation including variable-length dispatch/overlap/CPU-selected branches, live array class/stride and allocation identity, static-bitset disjointness from payloads, error/fallback paths, old-value preservation across resize and actual execution.
